program_name: MSP430 Microcontroller - Timers and Counters Ex 4
objective: Execute MSP430 16-bit timers and counters program 4.
theory: MSP430 by Texas Instruments is an ultra-low power 16-bit RISC microcontroller with 16 16-bit registers (R0-R15).
algorithm: 1. Read 16-bit word from RAM address 0x0200 into register R4.
flowchart: START -> Execute Timers and Counters Step 1 -> Process Data -> Verify Flags/Result -> END
assembly_code:
; MSP430 Assembly - Timers and Counters Ex 4
MOV &0x0200, R4
ADD #4, R4
MOV R4, &0x0202

opcode_table.mnemonic: ; MSP430 Assembly - Timers and Counters Ex 4

step_by_step_execution: Step 1: Fetch and decode Timers and Counters instruction for MSP430 Microcontroller.
Step 2: Read input operands from memory / registers.
Step 3: Execute ALU operation for Timers and Counters.
Step 4: Update status flags (Z, CY, S, P).
Step 5: Store final result into memory.
explanation: This program demonstrates timers and counters on the MSP430 Microcontroller architecture.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to clear carry or flags before loop.

viva_questions.q: Why is MSP430 widely used in battery-powered devices?
viva_questions.a: Due to its ultra-low power consumption (sub-microampere sleep modes).

practical_applications: Used in embedded control systems for timers and counters.
Commonly used in real-time sensor processing on MSP430 Microcontroller.
